data.long_meaning: The name Bidisha is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Vidisha’, which means ‘abode of knowledge’. In Hindu mythology, Bidisha is the goddess who is believed to be the embodiment of knowledge and wisdom. She is revered by scholars and students alike for her ability to bestow knowledge and understanding. The name Bidisha carries the meaning “Goddess of Knowledge” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bidisha usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of knowledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bidisha total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
